mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image(user_id, url, local_url, md5, origin, width, height, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{url}, #{localUrl}, #{md5}, #{origin}, #{width}, #{height}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM image i INNER JOIN image_tag it ON i.id = it.image_id INNER JOIN tag t ON it.tag_id = t.id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND t.name = #{tag} AND i.origin = 'collect' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_photo pp WHERE pp.image_id = i.id ) ORDER BY i.create_time DESC
SELECT i.* FROM image i WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.origin = 'collect' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_photo pp WHERE pp.image_id = i.id ) ORDER BY i.create_time DESC

SELECT t.name FROM image i INNER JOIN image_tag it ON i.id = it.image_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = it.tag_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.origin = 'collect' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY MAX(i.create_time) DESC, t.name ASC

SELECT t.name FROM image i INNER JOIN image_tag it ON i.id = it.image_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = it.tag_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.origin = 'collect' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, t.name ASC
SELECT t.name FROM tag t INNER JOIN image_tag it ON t.id = it.tag_id WHERE it.image_id = #{imageId} ORDER BY t.name ASC
SELECT id FROM tag WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE it FROM image_tag it INNER JOIN image i ON i.id = it.image_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND it.tag_id = #{tagId}
DELETE FROM image WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM image WHERE id = #{id} AND origin = 'project' FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM image WHERE id = #{id} AND origin = 'project'
